name: souffleur
description: A hidden prompter for calls: sees your screen, hears the room, invisible to screen share

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p bin && swiftc -O src/native/AudioTap.swift -o bin/audiotap && swiftc -O src/native/PdfText.swift -o bin/pdftext
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never

author: akshatgg
